'''Alvena''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Republic Army]] who served aboard the [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]] ''[[Dorin's Sky]]'' during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She, along with much of the ship's crew, fell in battle while [[Attack on the Dorin's Sky|unsuccessfully defending]] the ''Dorin's Sky'' from Imperial boarders.
